tagline: A standing challenge to human and artificial intelligence
hypothesis: In a specified service and boundary, improving usable system energy density may outperform feasible alternatives on a declared binding constraint without violating agreed safeguards. This has not been established.
first_assignment: Determine whether energy density is the right problem framing before prioritizing solutions.
core_question: Can sufficiently capable human-AI and AI-AI research systems discover interventions that substantially increase useful energy availability per constrained resource while decreasing total system-level environmental and economic costs?
harder_question: Or are we merely moving energy, entropy, cost, risk, materials, or environmental damage somewhere less visible?
objectives: Identify a service deficit and the binding constraint.
Compare density with the baseline and feasible alternatives.
Report service quality, total burdens and per-service metrics.
Retain, narrow, replace or leave the framing unresolved based on evidence.
constraints: No causal leverage claim from connectivity.
No global inference from one application.
No evidence promotion from AI agreement.
